rule: docs/TREE_PLAN.md: high street (pilot), Amber spine, arterials - trees in wells on the shop side, palms alternating on Amber (zone 406 -> about 360); this block's trees stand on grass round its buildings, not in street wells
written: by hand, 19 Nov 2026 (cloud session, the city-wide superchecker run from the bottom of the list). The block's eleven builder trees go (corals, jacarandas, magnolias, palms, a ficus against a dumpster, a torrey pine 0.4 m from a wall); four come back on their own spots on open grass: the car park's edge, two of the front row (every other one), and one clear corner.

trees.why: the car park's grass edge by the agave and the wheel stops: a queen palm where the cars come in
the grass strip along the front row, 3.7 m from the wall: every other tree of the old row
the same strip's east end, 42 m on: a palm, alternating with the coral as on Amber
the open grass at the block's west corner, 4.3 m from the wall, nothing round it
